solves.reason: The passage discusses an 'explosion' of popular music (positive growth), a 'relaxed' attitude (ease), and 'inclusive' approach (open to all). All antonyms (decline/rigid/exclusive) contradict the passage tone.
Punk movement embodies 'rebellion' (not conformity), 'non-virtuosic' music (anyone can play), and 'accessible' to all (not inaccessible). The freedom/rebellion pairing is clear.
Global 'circulation' and 'dissemination' (spread) of music by creative industries. Groups 'excluded' (shut out) from music then got opportunities. restriction/suppression/included are antonyms.
② exclusive contradicts the passage meaning. The original is 'inclusive' - an open, welcoming attitude. exclusive means the opposite.
③ welcomed contradicts passage. Original says 'excluded from music' - these groups were shut out, not welcomed. They later revelled in opportunities.
③ lamented (mourned/grieved) contradicts passage. Original says 'revelled' (took great pleasure). Finding joy, not sorrow, in creating music.

Understanding of ___: The passage describes how anyone could start a band, non-virtuosic music, accessible to all = accessibility. freedom exists in passage but doesn't fit 'understanding of ___ in relation to music'.
Spirit of ___ and freedom: Punk movement, counter-culture = rebellion. Obedience/attitude/discipline contradict the anti-establishment spirit.
Sense of ___ and empowerment: Previously excluded groups creating for the first time = novelty (newness). Rebellion doesn't pair with empowerment. anxiety/isolation are negative.
dissemination = the act of spreading information widely. spreading is the closest synonym. collection (gathering) and restriction/destruction are unrelated.
propelled = pushed forward, drove. 'drove forward' captures the meaning of propelling a new understanding. hindered/delayed/prevented all mean the opposite.
revelled = took great delight. delighted is the closest synonym. suffered/hesitated/complained express negative emotions or different actions.
inclusive = including all. Opposite = exclusive (excluding). welcoming/open/embracing are all near-synonyms of inclusive.
empowerment = giving power/capability. Opposite = subjugation (domination/oppression). authority/enablement/liberation share positive power connotations.
(A) 'a spirit of rebellion' = mindset/ethos (정신). (B) 'showed spirit and fought back' = fighting spirit/grit (투지). Ghost/liquor/character don't fit these contexts.
Quality of being easy to reach/enter/use by everyone = accessibility. exclusivity is the opposite. complexity and popularity describe different qualities.
accessible (adj) → accessibility (noun). 'understanding of ___' requires a noun. -ibility suffix converts adjective to abstract noun.
create (verb) → creative (adjective). 'the ___ industries' needs an adjective modifier. -ive suffix converts verb to adjective.
Driven by ___: leads to punk movement, non-virtuosic music, accessible to all = a spirit of rebellion and freedom. Other options don't connect to these outcomes.
Music by ___: The creative industries handle global circulation and dissemination of music. punk movement is a result, not a distributor. academic/military are irrelevant.
